note: Refresh cadence is a separate dimension from registry scope. It does NOT change requiredEachReport (which remains the scope key across capture/adapter/manifest). IB stays live every report; the nine covered Sharesight portfolios are captured once per Asia/Hong_Kong week (Monday = capture/week key, not a valuation date).

sharesightWeekly.staleRetention: keep last good snapshot, shown explicitly dated as previous-week/historical; rollover never advances stored dates

notPositionsFallback: The IB-HK (936247) weekly snapshot is never a live IB positions fallback.
durableStore: not-activated: no safe durable private Sharesight store is configured; every non-Monday report takes the explicit degraded SS path until a separately reviewed store is added. No raw Sharesight holdings in the repo or Pages; no fee-Gist reuse.
